verdict.rationale: Pipedream publishes its REST API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.4 document on its docs domain, and its docs llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" alongside a second Conduit API spec. The interactive, AI-friendly API reference reinforces machine consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and stays in sync with the live API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Pipedream publishes its REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.4 document (info title "Pipedream REST API", version 2.0.0, server https://api.pipedream.com) on its own docs domain
the docs llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" together with a second Conduit API spec
